title: Kevin O'Connell lauds Kyler Murray, JJ McCarthy for 'very professional' competition

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Kevin O'Connell lauds Kyler Murray, JJ McCarthy for 'very professional' competition
sources.description: The Vikings are letting Kyler Murray and J.J. McCarthy battle for the starting quarterback job. Kevin O'Connell is happy with how it is progressing.
